cases.question: How is revenue doing this month?
expected_behavior: The agent starts with analyze_metric and reads the decision signals
The agent reports the move on more than one horizon using the to-date-versus-previous comparisons
The agent names the mechanism from get_metric_drivers and the recorded why before recommending anything
cases.ground_truth: A 'how is X doing' question runs the full investigation sequence unless analyze_metric reports stable.

cases.question: Why did conversion rate drop last week?
expected_behavior: The agent calls analyze_metric, then get_metric_drivers for the mechanism
The agent reads the recorded context before speculating about a cause
The agent checks prior art: tasks, workflow runs and initiatives already targeting the metric

cases.question: Churn has been creeping up for a couple of months. Nothing dramatic, but it is worrying me. What is going on?
expected_behavior: The agent treats a drifting status as something to investigate, not as stable
The agent uses the trailing and to-date comparisons to date the change

cases.question: What drives our average order value?
expected_behavior: The agent calls get_metric_drivers once and leads with the mapped drivers
The agent does not present a statistical correlation as a confirmed cause and never exposes ranking scores

cases.question: Is the fall in bookings seasonal, or is something actually wrong?
expected_behavior: The agent reads the same-period-last-year comparisons before attributing the fall to seasonality or ruling it out
The agent still names the mechanism and the recorded why

cases.question: Has anything been done about the drop in trial sign-ups?
expected_behavior: The agent checks get_tasks_for_metric, list_workflows with list_workflow_runs, and list_initiatives before answering
The agent never says nothing has been done without having looked

cases.question: Break revenue down by sales channel for me.
expected_behavior: The agent calls compare_dimension_metrics without a dimension first to discover the dimensions, then with the channel dimension
The agent reports contribution, not just the per-channel numbers
